result:
I’d increase the world’s ability to understand each other honestly and clearly—across languages, cultures, and perspectives.

A lot of conflict, injustice, and missed progress comes not from malice, but from misunderstanding, fear, bad incentives, and fragmented communication. If people could communicate more honestly, listen more carefully, and better understand shared stakes, then so many other problems—war, inequality, environmental collapse, isolation—would become far easier to solve.
